feature_schema.doc: A cylindrical mounting boss with a co-axial pilot bore, stamped onto a seat frame and fused to the host (PowerCopy/UDF reference, issue #139). Supply a placement frame by name (interface / f_ face tag / literal) plus a boss diameter; publishes a 'boss_top' seat for what mounts on it.

refs.name: seat
refs.doc: Placement frame the boss sits on: a published interface name, an f_/e_ tag, or a literal {origin, z_axis?, x_axis?}.

inputs.name: bore_dia_mm
inputs.doc: Co-axial pilot bore diameter (0 => solid boss).

bolt_schema.doc: A circular bolt pattern: `count` blind holes on a bolt circle in a reference frame, drilled into the host (issue #139). Supply the frame by name plus the circle diameter, count, and thread; thread rides as metadata (machined, not modeled). Publishes a 'bolt_circle' interface.

refs.name: frame
refs.doc: Bolt-circle frame: a published interface name, an f_/e_ tag, or a literal {origin, z_axis?, x_axis?}.

inputs.name: circle_dia_mm
inputs.doc: Bolt-circle diameter (hole centers lie on it).

inputs.name: depth_mm
inputs.doc: Drill depth into the host along -z.

inputs.name: thread
inputs.doc: Tapped thread spec carried as metadata (not modeled).
